customManagers.description: Pinned release versions (VERSION=...) of the home-assistant init-container extensions (Lovelace cards + custom integrations).
KubeVirt and CDI operator GitHub-release URLs in kustomization.yaml.

Generic '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' annotations directly above a 'key: image:tag' or 'key: version' line — covers flat-string images in local charts (media stack), hardcoded images in chart templates, tag-only helm values (mosquitto), and NAS container images in Ansible role defaults.

packageRules.description: kubeseal-webgui v4.10+ has a broken kubernetes-client v36 in-cluster auth (api_key key mismatch). Disable auto-merge until upstream fixes it.
Postgres major version upgrades require a manual pg_upgrade of the data directory — never auto-merge them.
